source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "errorlogs" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i log (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the error-log OID subtree so the user confirms the errorlogs SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Collect a bounded BMC error-log object set through SNMPv3 and verify expected records, severity and chronology without clearing evidence.
original_method: Engineer configures v3 and browses undefined `$target`; no time window, log source or expected events are defined.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/SNMPv3 and supplies event scope; bounded read-only retrieval, normalization and comparison are automated.
safety_requirements: Never clear, acknowledge or mutate logs in this case.
Bound rows/time and protect credentials, serials and incident data.
Preserve first failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, retrieve bounded exact objects, normalize timestamps/severity and compare expected events.
Do not clear logs, configure WebUI or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve log schema/window/redaction and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic v2c/full walk can use the wrong subtree, overload BMC or expose sensitive content.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor log-table SNMPv3 objects with bounded paging and redaction.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define a finite log table/window and expected event set, collect through v3 with pagination, preserve raw ordering and correlate with SEL/BMC time.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic window, schema and preservation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tests log semantics without destructive clear.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Clock drift and rollover affect correlation.

project_override_considerations: Project defines the expected event/window and may redact identifiers while retaining event identity and chronology.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure/Criteria change clients, `$target` is undefined, and DeepSeek changes to v2c plus unbounded generic log output.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Log schema, window and expected records are project inputs. With manual setup, bounded collection is automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Retains evidence-preservation rules without conflating missing inputs with incapability.

review_improvement: Adds finite query scope, chronology and no-clear protection.
independent_technical_reasoning: The intent to monitor error logs is clear. Owner-provided schema/window makes it deterministic; manual SNMP configuration is setup before automated evidence collection.
